dct_description_sm: The Nunatsiavut Government in partnership with the universities of Trent and Memorial conducted four pilot research projects in Nain to understand climate change impacts and potential adaptation measures from a community perspective. The four programs included: (1) Examining past and present environmental data and conducting interviews and focus groups to identify key environmental hazard conditions, socio-economic impacts, and adaptation needs; (2)an assessment of community water security, determinants of vulnerability to quality, access, and availability of drinking water, and adaptation strategies at present (3); establishment of community sea ice monitoring stations with training for monitors and weekly dissemination of ice information. Several recommendations came from this project that further research programs hoped to implement.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Development of an Inuit Focused Climate Change Program in Nain, Nunatiavut: Determining Impacts and Adapting for a Healthy Future While Building Capacity
